title: Government holds close-range cell phone video of triangles

tellings.quote: I know directly that right now in our government there is cell phone video ending the conversation about the triangles once and for for all.
I I know for a fact there are cell phone videos of triangles. Undeniable. End of discussion.
tellings.difference: Calls the videos classified, but does not say the government holds them or that they were shot at close range.
tellings.link_reason: Both are Borland's claim that cell phone video of the triangles exists and ends the debate.

as_told.title: Classified cell phone videos of triangles

plain: Dylan Borland says the US government has close-range cell phone video of the triangles, the large triangular craft people report seeing, and that it would settle the question for good: "there is cell phone video ending the conversation about the triangles once and for for all." He tells Michels he knows this directly, and elsewhere in the same talk he calls the videos classified and "Undeniable. End of discussion," without saying who holds them. If true, clear proof of the triangles is already sitting in government hands.
